news_codex_ratings.json.review_mode: Scheduled cloud dual-review; independent Codex desk
limitations: Confidence values are subjective evidence confidence, not return probabilities. News remains unweighted in the trading score.

Only material new or materially changed evidence is newly reviewed in this run. Unchanged same-session ATRL and Oil Marketing ratings from codex-0951 are carried forward unchanged so the desk file does not erase still-valid current-session context.

The linked Business Recorder Fauji Foods article was not accessible in this cloud session. Its committed raw-feed headline/snippet was treated as headline-only; the underlying resignation event was independently verified from a full ProPakistani article and the official PSX FFL company identity.

The fresh oil articles are a continuation of the middle-east-oil-supply-shock thread. They show a modest stabilization/short-covering bounce rather than a fundamental reversal, so the existing weak-positive upstream ratings are retained rather than strengthened.
The Mettis raw-feed timestamp for the external-financing story was offset inconsistently; the article page itself states September 22, 2026 at 10:48 AM GMT+05:00, which is used here.

A concurrent raw-news refresh added the FCCL BESS/solar headline. The linked Mettis article was not accessible and its raw timestamp is inconsistent with the run clock, so it is reviewed as headline-only positive direct evidence but is not promoted into the score-bearing ratings block.

reviewed_stories.title: Fauji Foods CEO Usman Zaheer resigns
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Direct governance event for Fauji Foods Limited (PSX: FFL), whose identity is verified on the official PSX company page.
reviewed_stories.reason: Usman Zaheer Ahmed resigned as CEO effective September 18 and will continue through his notice period while the board appoints a successor. The leadership change is real and company-specific, but no earnings, cash-flow, ownership or strategic impact is disclosed, so the evidence is neutral.
reviewed_stories.publication_time_status: Full ProPakistani article states September 21, 2026 at 7:23 PM PKT. The newer Business Recorder republication is headline/snippet-only in this cloud session, so its raw-feed clock is not used as the verified publication anchor.

reviewed_stories.title: Oil rises slightly ahead of potential US-Iran talks
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Sector linkage to tracked upstream producers OGDC, PPL and MARI through realized hydrocarbon prices.
reviewed_stories.reason: Brent stabilized around $100-$102 after several sessions of declines, but the Reuters-carried article describes the move as short covering rather than a fundamental shift, while Saudi Aramco increased Gulf exports and diplomacy remained possible. This does not materially strengthen or reverse the existing weak-positive upstream thread.
reviewed_stories.publication_time_status: Business Recorder article page states Published September 22, 2026 and Updated 07:50 AM PKT; Mettis article page states September 22, 2026 at 10:10 AM GMT+05:00.

reviewed_stories.title: Pakistan's external financing hits $939m in August
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Macro sovereign-financing data with no traceable company-specific or configured sector cash-flow mechanism for the tracked universe.
reviewed_stories.reason: Pakistan received $939.53 million in external financing in August and $1.70 billion in July-August, including a $300 million UBL Dubai commercial loan. This is relevant macro-liquidity context, but the article does not establish a direct or sector-specific effect on the tracked PSX companies, so it is not converted into a stock or sector rating.
reviewed_stories.publication_time_status: Mettis Global article page states September 22, 2026 at 10:48 AM GMT+05:00.

reviewed_stories.title: Fauji Cement approves BESS installation with dedicated solar plants
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Direct company project headline for Fauji Cement Company Limited (PSX: FCCL), whose identity is verified on the official PSX company page.
reviewed_stories.reason: The headline indicates board approval for battery energy storage with dedicated solar plants, which is directionally supportive because captive storage and solar can reduce purchased-energy exposure and improve reliability. The article body, project capacity, capex, commissioning schedule and quantified savings were not accessible, so the evidence is headline-only and confidence is limited.
reviewed_stories.publication_time_status: Unverified. The committed raw feed reports 2026-09-22T11:46:00+00:00, which would be in the future relative to this run if interpreted literally. The linked article page was not accessible, so no corrected publication timestamp is invented.

ATRL.reason: Intermarket Securities' full ATRL initiation points to higher utilization, stronger product yields and brownfield-upgrade economics, but the upside is forecast- and execution-dependent rather than a new operating disclosure.
ATRL.relevance: Direct link: Attock Refinery Limited (ATRL), verified as a PSX-listed refinery.

FFL.reason: The CEO resignation is a direct governance event, but the verified evidence discloses no earnings, cash-flow, ownership or strategic effect; the successor is still to be appointed.
FFL.relevance: Direct link: Fauji Foods Limited (PSX: FFL), verified on the official PSX company page.

OGDC.reason: Brent remains around $100-$102 amid the conflict, but the latest bounce is described as short covering while Saudi export recovery and possible US-Iran talks keep the upstream tailwind weak.
OGDC.relevance: Sector link: Oil & Gas Exploration; OGDC directly sells produced hydrocarbons.

PPL.reason: Brent remains around $100-$102 amid the conflict, but the latest bounce is described as short covering while Saudi export recovery and possible US-Iran talks keep the upstream tailwind weak.
PPL.relevance: Sector link: Oil & Gas Exploration; PPL directly sells produced hydrocarbons.

MARI.reason: The conflict still supports hydrocarbon pricing, but the latest crude bounce is not presented as a fundamental reversal and recovering Saudi flows keep the crude-price tailwind weak. Confidence stays lower because crude is only part of MARI's hydrocarbon exposure.
MARI.relevance: Sector link: Oil & Gas Exploration; MARI produces and sells hydrocarbons.

Oil Marketing.reason: Today's petrol/HSD reset changes import and retail prices, but the OMC profit margin remains fixed at Rs7.87/litre, so the reset itself is neutral for OMC unit margins.
Oil Marketing.relevance: Sector link: Oil Marketing, including PSO.
